title: AppRegistration
description:
How clients may join the app on their own. A client that registers names no app: the app is the one
whose API its first authorization request names as `resource`, and the client may ask only for that
app's `third_party` APIs, each with the user's consent. Both ways are off when left out, because open
registration is an abuse surface (ADR 078).

client_id_metadata_documents.description: A client may use an HTTPS URL as its `client_id`, and the document behind it says who it is (ADR 082 §9). What MCP clients use.

dynamic.description: A client may register through RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, for clients that register no other way.
